fullDescription: A premium neumorphic (Soft UI) dashboard design system characterized by sophisticated depth, light-source-driven shadows, and a rich layer of dynamic micro-interactions. Utilizing a palette of soft greys (#e0e5ec) and deep navy (#1e2030), the interface features highly tactile elements with 'extruded' and 'inset' appearances. The design is optimized for SaaS dashboards, fintech platforms, and administrative consoles requiring a modern, playful, yet professional aesthetic. Key features include staggered cascade animations, pulse effects on status indicators, and moving gradient progress bars.
prompt:
## Resumo
A modern, highly animated neumorphic dashboard featuring a soft-shadow aesthetic across light and dark modes. It uses high-contrast depth effects, fluid typography (Satoshi and General Sans), and a heavy emphasis on state-driven animations like ripples, bobs, and counts.

## Estilo Visual
Create a Neumorphic design system. ### Color Palette: Light Mode: Background #e0e5ec, Highlight #ffffff, Shadow #a3b1c6. Dark Mode: Background #1e2030, Highlight #2a2d42, Shadow #14152a. ### Typography: Headings in 'General Sans', semi-bold (600), tracking -0.02em. Body in 'Satoshi', medium (500) or regular (400). ### Elevation: 'nm-flat' uses 6px 6px 12px shadows; 'nm-inset' uses inset 4px 4px 8px shadows. ### Animations: Timing function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Hover transitions: scale(1.02) and translateY(-4px). ### Icons: Use Lucide-style line icons with floating animations (5px vertical bob every 3s).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar
A 288px wide sidebar. Includes a top brand card using 'nm-flat' styling. Navigation links use 'Satoshi' (14px, font-medium) and transition from flat to inset when 'active'. Links have a subtle background gradient slide-in from the left on hover. Bottom section contains a Neumorphic settings button.

### Sticky Header
Height: 72px. Floating 16px from the top with rounded-3xl corners. Left side: breadcrumbs with rotating chevron icons. Center: Search bar using 'nm-inset' with 288px width. Right side: Circular Neumorphic buttons for theme toggle and notifications (with a pulsing status dot), ending with a gradient-filled avatar.

### Statistics Grid
4-column grid for desktop, 1-column for mobile. Each card is 'nm-flat-hover'. Top-left of card: an icon in an 'nm-inset' square performing a 'floatBob' animation. Bottom-left: a large counter (font-size: 30px, bold) that increments from 0 to target on load. Bottom-right: a 'trend' indicator with a sliding horizontal animation on hover.

### Activity and Status Widgets
Two-column bottom layout. 'Recent Activity' uses staggered 'slide-bounce' entrance for items. Each item is separated by a transparent-to-slate gradient divider. 'Hardware Pulse' section features progress bars with a 'progress-track' (inset) and 'progress-fill' (animated gradient with moving stripes). Progress fills must have a 'glowPulse' filter effect.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Animated Progress Bar — Tactile progress indicator with depth and motion.
Implementation: Outer container 'nm-inset' with 10px height and 999px radius. Inner fill uses a multi-stop linear gradient (e.g., #6366f1 to #a78bfa). Add a pseudo-element over the fill with a 200% width shimmer gradient moving via @keyframes waveShimmer. Add 'filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px currentColor)' with a pulse animation for a neon glow effect.

### Neumorphic Ripple Button — Interactive button with physical feedback.
Style as 'nm-button' (flat with slight scale on hover). On click, inject a span with 'position: absolute', 'border-radius: 50%', and a radial-gradient background. Animate the span from scale(0) to scale(4) and opacity(0.5) to opacity(0) over 0.7s using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Ensure 'overflow: hidden' is on the parent button.

### Interactive Terminal Widget — A console-style readout with typing effects.
Use a rounded-2xl 'nm-inset' container. Header includes three colored dots (rose, amber, emerald). Content uses a monospaced font (11px). Include a 'cursor-blink' animation after the last character. Animate lines appearing with 300ms staggered delays and a 10px X-axis slide.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain the light source from the top-left (negative shadows are light, positive shadows are dark). MUST: Use staggered delays (50ms increments) for all entrance animations to create a cascading effect. MUST NOT: Use flat borders; use box-shadows to define all edges. MUST NOT: Use high-opacity blacks; rely on tinted shadows for the neumorphic effect to remain 'soft'.

style.description: The style is defined by Neumorphism (Soft UI) using a dual-shadow technique to create depth. Colors rely on #e0e5ec for light background and #1e2030 for dark mode. Typography pairings use 'General Sans' for bold, structured headings and 'Satoshi' for readable body text. Animations are central, utilizing complex cubic-bezier curves (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)) for 'bouncy' and 'organic' transitions. Interactive components feature smooth scaling, icon wiggles, and click-triggered radial ripple waves.
